title: More ways to chat with images
summary:
Vision chat gained new models, the community showcase grew, and Gemini and audio configurations got some necessary housekeeping.

Pixtral 12B and `llama-vision` were added as vision-capable chat options, while `phi` was configured as Phi-4 Instruct. Image generation was also adjusted so requests fall through to ComfyUI after a Cloudflare Flux failure.

The community showcase added StoryMagic for customizable children's stories, roastmyselfie.app for selfie roasts, and RoastMaster AI for selfie and text roasts. The project submission form also got simpler.

The project lists added a multi-model AI Chat Assistant, the realtime Pollinations Feed art showcase, the Elixpo Art browser extension, and the Jackey image-generation Discord bot. Related Elixpo listings were consolidated.

highlights.title: More vision chat options
highlights.text: Chat with images using Pixtral 12B or `llama-vision`. [Explore llama-vision](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama-vision).

highlights.title: Phi-4 Instruct joins chat
highlights.text: Try Phi-4 Instruct through the `phi` model option. [Explore phi](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=phi).
